metadata.title: Rustic Country Album Box Set Layout

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered layout featuring a central portrait framed by a textured border, an orange header bar, and a prominent diagonal black sash for promotional text.
excludeWhen: layouts without a central photographic subject

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured composition utilizing a thick, textured sepia-toned border that contains a central photograph of a man in rustic attire against a brick building. The top is defined by a horizontal orange bar with white serif text, while the bottom right is dominated by a 45-degree black diagonal sash containing bold orange and white text.
coreVisualRelationships: The orange header bar balances the heavy black diagonal sash in the bottom right.
The textured outer frame creates a vintage, tactile feel around the sharp central image.
The vertical lines of the background architecture contrast with the diagonal movement of the sash.
The white serif typography provides a clean focal point against the saturated orange and black backgrounds.
coreInvariants: A thick, distressed outer border with radial sunburst texture.
A horizontal header bar in a burnt orange hue.
A diagonal black sash cutting across the bottom right corner.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the left third of the inner frame, medium shot, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange header bar at the top serves as the primary anchor for the artist's name.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the orange header, moves down to the subject's face, and then follows the diagonal sash upward from the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is utilized in the upper right of the inner frame, featuring a subtle watermark-like graphic over a light tan panel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Burnt orange used for the header and primary promotional text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black used for the diagonal sash to create a sharp break from the rustic background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sepia and tan tones in the border and background architecture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (orange/black) contrasts with the muted, naturalistic tones of the photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic high-contrast serif and clean sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a wide-set, high-contrast serif with sharp terminals.
Promotional text on the sash uses a bold, condensed sans-serif for the headline and a light serif for the body.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a functional condensed sans-serif for promotional callouts.

preserve: The diagonal orientation of the corner text
The wide-tracked serif for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary classic serif authority for the main title.
Matches the bold, condensed nature of the diagonal sash headline.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a rustic scene with a man in a green jacket and orange shirt standing before a red brick building. Frame this with a thick, textured sepia border featuring a subtle radial sunburst. Include a solid orange bar at the top and a solid black diagonal sash in the bottom right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a white, wide-tracked serif font centered in the orange bar. Add promotional text in a bold orange condensed sans-serif along the diagonal of the black sash, followed by smaller white serif body text below it.

verificationChecks: Is the orange header bar present and containing white serif text?
Is the black sash oriented at a 45-degree angle in the bottom right?
Does the outer border have a distressed, sepia texture?
Is the main title text wide-tracked and all-caps?

mustRedesign: Specific tracklist or box set details

mustAchieve: Clean typographic alignment within the geometric bars
Visible texture in the outer frame
Clear hierarchy between the header and the sash
avoid: Misalignment of the diagonal text to the sash angle

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the diagonal text is perfectly parallel to the sash edges.
Check that the orange in the header matches the orange in the sash text.
Verify the sepia border does not overlap the central subject's face.
Confirm the serif font has high contrast between thick and thin strokes.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rustic photographic subject with a structured geometric frame consisting of a top horizontal color bar and a bottom-right diagonal sash, using high-contrast serif and condensed sans-serif typography.
